title: Amide-linked hole transporting material for solid-state dye-sensitised solar cells
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,11988-11997
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09351A, Paper
Open Access

Amy Neild, Owen Woodford, Pablo Docampo, Elizabeth A. Gibson
Our study introduces TPABT as a new amide-based hole transport mediator that delivers a marked improvement in device efficiency from 0.04% to 2.26% through prolonged air oxidation and light soaking.
